title: build-wheel workflow GitHub install check: install a commit-pinned GitHub archive tarball, not a git+ requirement
answers: Why is the GitHub wheel installation check in CI slow or timing out when it installs MLflow from the tested commit?
How does the build-wheel CI job install the libs/skinny or libs/tracing subdirectory from a specific commit?
Where is the CI step that verifies the built MLflow wheel installs from GitHub at the checked-out commit?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml (the GitHub installation step in the build-wheel job) takes the checked-out commit from `git rev-parse HEAD` and runs `uv run --isolated --no-project --with <URL>` for the root package, `libs/skinny`, or `libs/tracing` (selected by MATRIX_TYPE) to confirm `import mlflow` works from GitHub.
Rule: Build the URL as `https://github.com/${REPO}/archive/${REF}.tar.gz`, appending `#subdirectory=libs/${MATRIX_TYPE}` for non-dev matrix entries and nothing for `dev`. Do not use a `git+https://github.com/...git@${REF}` requirement, because `uv` fetches the full Git history for `git+` requirements.
Symptom: The installation check took 33-43s per leg and was vulnerable to transient Git backend failures, so the 240s per-attempt timeout meant a failed attempt waited four minutes before retrying. After the change the step runs in about 19-30s and the per-attempt timeout is 120s.
Constraints: Applies to the build-wheel workflow's install-from-GitHub verification. Pinning to the commit SHA keeps the test on the exact commit that built the wheel. Retry loop (3 attempts) and `timeout -k 10` wrapper are kept as they were. Does not cover the wheel build itself or other workflows.
applies: CI verification step in .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml that installs MLflow from a GitHub commit; not general pip or uv usage.
says: The wheel installation check in CI is running very slowly and timing out.
Speed up the automated GitHub package install step to prevent four-minute retry delays.
Installation verification fails frequently in the build pipeline due to transient repository timeouts.
Reduce build workflow runtimes by downloading a release archive instead of full history.
search: In .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml, the GitHub installation verification step must install a commit-pinned archive tarball from https://github.com/${REPO}/archive/${REF}.tar.gz rather than using a git+ requirement with uv. Using git+ forces uv to download the entire Git history, causing slow runs and 240-second timeout delays on transient failures. This guidance applies specifically to the build-wheel install check across root, libs/skinny, and libs/tracing matrix builds while preserving the three-attempt retry loop and per-attempt timeout.
